reason: The image-only reading gave the text without a source; reread at the sermon openings and two body columns with Schneyer's incipits and Clm 3764 in hand, abbreviations were expanded and uncertain words resolved against the series' wording.
sources: J. B. Schneyer, Repertorium der lateinischen Sermones des Mittelalters II (Münster 1970), pp. 649-665, Henricus de Friemar, series 2, nos. 142, 160-163, 170, 175-180 (Google Books snippets, t9O5AAAAIAAJ)
Munich, BSB, Clm 3764, ff. 200v-201r and 202r-202v, MDZ bsb00114305, scans 412-413 and 415-416 (page images, black-and-white microfilm)
Handschriftenportal records for Clm 3764 (old table of contents: 'Sermones henrici de frimaria erfordensis conuentus Augustinorum') and Lübeck, Ms. theol. lat. 2° 126, ff. 1ra-17ra
text:
Source-assisted reading (research reader), made on the native images after the image-only first reading stams4-2026-10-31-image-only, with Schneyer's incipits (snippets) and Clm 3764 (page images) in hand. Reread on the image: 1r col. d (canvas 0), 1v col. a (canvas 1), the tops of col. c on canvases 1 and 5, and sermon openings and explicits around the red initials and rubrics of canvases 2-13. 1r col. a and 1v col. b rest on the first reading. Images: https://fragmentarium.ms/loris/F-cb2e/Stams_STA_Frg_080_01r.jpg (canvas 0) to ..._07v.jpg (canvas 13). Regions are x,y,width,height in native pixels. Expansions in ( ), uncertain readings (?), lost or unread [..], line breaks /.

A. Canvas 0 (1r), col. d, 5150,2350,1450,2210
... De quib(us) Mt 6 Cu(m) ieiunat(is) / nolite fieri sic(ut) yp(ocr)ite t(ri)st(es). / De 2o dicit Ph(ilosophu)s 1o Posterior(um) / p(ro)pt(er) q(uo)d unu(m)q(uo)dq(ue) tale et illud / mag(is). Sed cu(m) vinea dilig(itur) / p(ro)pt(er) fructu(s), fruct(us) au(tem) eccl(es)ie / s(un)t a(n)i(m)e que diligu(n)t(ur)(?) ab an-/[gel]is(?) a vineis p(ro)p(ter) delectac(i)o(nem) istius / vinee xp(istu)s mortuus est / [vinea, struck out in red] Et figuratu(m) e(st) Regu(m) / 21o. Vbi legit(ur) q(uod) Naboth / p(ro) vinea sua mortuus e(st). / Vinea e(st) eccl(es)ia, Naboth xp(istu)s. / Ad illa(m) vinea(m) excolenda(m) / misit deus ap(osto)los, s(an)c(t)os doc-/tores et adhuc ho(die) p(re)dica-/tores quib(us) ip(s)e dicit Ite.

B. Canvas 1 (1v), col. a, 1450,1650,1500,2150
... vinee firmate sunt custo-/dijs Mt 22 Erat p(ate)rfamilias / qui plantau(it) vinea(m) et circu(m)de-/dit ei sepem et fodit in ea tor-/cular et edificauit t(ur)rim in me(di)o / eius. Pat(er)familias / i(d est) pater celestis plantau(it) vi-/nea(m) i(d est) eccl(es)iam et sepem c(ir)-/cu(m)dedit ei i(d est) firmauit / ea(m) diuina sc(ri)ptura et fodit / torcular in ea i(d est) fecit / p(er)fodi manus et pedes et / latus filii sui et edificauit / t(ur)rim i(d est) in medio(?) / p(er) qua(m) firmauit eccle-/siam ut inimici i(d est) dyaboli / c(ontra) ea(m) no(n) possint sed / [?]ubitate(?) ad fuga(m)(?) [ending uncertain] / [red] D(omi)nica in Sexagesima / [A]liud cecidit in terra(m) / bona(m) et c(etera). Luc 8o / No(ta) q(uod) t(er)ra i(d est) a(n)i(m)a ut fructi-/ficat deb(et) fieri trib(us) mo-/dis. s(cilicet) De p(ri)mo p(ri)me / impinguari ... erit con[fessionis ...]
